howItWorks.title: How Nexusply
howItWorks.description: We've simplified the complex world of global sourcing into a streamlined 4-step process powered by advanced data intelligence.

step1.title: 1. Connect Data Sources
step1.desc: Nexusply aggregates live data from global marketplaces like Alibaba, 1688, and CJ Dropshipping, providing you with a unified dashboard.

step2.title: 2. Analyze & Compare
step2.desc: Use our AI engine to compare MOQ, shipping times, and reliability scores across thousands of verified manufacturers instantly.

step3.title: 3. Identify Winners
step3.desc: Our profit simulator calculates real margins, helping you spot trending products with high demand and low competition.

step4.title: 4. Scale With AI
step4.desc: Receive daily AI-driven recommendations on stock levels, price adjustments, and new sourcing opportunities to dominate your niche.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Nexusply, we take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect information you provide directly to us when you create an account, such as your name, email address, and payment information. We also collect usage data to improve our services.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use your information to provide and maintain our services, process transactions, and communicate with you about updates or promotional offers.

sections.title: 3. Data Security
sections.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

sections.title: 4. Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time through your account settings.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using Nexusply, you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing or using our platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations.

sections.title: 2. User Accounts
sections.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password. You must be at least 18 years old to use our services.

sections.title: 3. Subscription and Billing
sections.content: Certain features require a paid subscription. All fees are non-refundable unless required by law.

sections.title: 4. Prohibited Conduct
sections.content: You agree not to use the platform for any unlawful purpose or in any way that could damage or impair our services.
